breadcrumb: Std 6 Social Science Term-II (English) — History Unit 3: From Chiefdoms to Empires — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: The fertile soil of the Gangetic Valley and the use of iron ploughshares improved agricultural productivity. Knowledge in the use of iron gave Magadha an advantage over other Mahajanapadas.

en.q: Magadha gained an advantage over other Mahajanapadas because of its knowledge of the use of ______.
en.explanation: Iron improved agriculture and craft production, giving Magadha an edge.

ta.q: மகதம் பிற மகாஜனபதங்களைவிட முன்னிலை பெறக் காரணம் ______ பயன்பாட்டு அறிவு.

questions.quote: Gana - sanghas - non monarchical states; Kingdoms - monarchies. The term 'gana' means 'people of equal status'. 'Sangha' means 'assembly'.

en.q: Non-monarchical states of the sixth century BCE were called ______.
en.explanation: 'Gana' means people of equal status; 'sangha' means assembly.

ta.q: கி.மு. ஆறாம் நூற்றாண்டில் முடியாட்சியற்ற அரசுகள் ______ எனப்பட்டன.

questions.quote: Sixteen Mahajanapadas: Kuru, Panchala, Anga, Magadha, Vajji, Malla, Kasi, Kosala, Avanti, Chedi, Vatsa, Machcha, Surasena, Assaka, Gandhara and Kamboja. Four major: Magadha in Bihar, Avanti in Ujjain, Kosala in Eastern Uttar Pradesh and Vatsa in Kausambi, Allahabad.

en.q: Avanti, one of the four major Mahajanapadas, had its capital at ______.
en.explanation: Vatsa was in Kausambi (Allahabad), Magadha in Bihar and Kosala in eastern Uttar Pradesh.

ta.q: நான்கு முக்கிய மகாஜனபதங்களுள் ஒன்றான அவந்தி ______ ஐ மையமாகக் கொண்டிருந்தது.

questions.quote: Magadha's gradual rise to political supremacy began with Bimbisara of Haryanka dynasty. His son Ajatasatru convened the first Buddhist Council at Rajagriha. Udayin laid the foundation of the new capital at Pataliputra.

en.q: Who convened the first Buddhist Council at Rajagriha?
en.explanation: Kalasoka convened the second at Vaishali; Ashoka the third at Pataliputra.

ta.explanation: காலசோகர் இரண்டாவது சங்கத்தை வைசாலியிலும் அசோகர் மூன்றாவதை பாடலிபுத்திரத்திலும் கூட்டினர்.

questions.quote: Nandas were the first empire builders of India. The first Nanda ruler was Mahapadma. Mahapadma Nanda was succeeded by his eight sons, known as Navanandas (nine Nandas). Dhana Nanda, the last Nanda ruler, was overthrown by Chandragupta Maurya.

en.q: The last Nanda ruler, overthrown by Chandragupta Maurya, was ______.
en.explanation: The Nandas were the first empire builders of India.

ta.q: சந்திரகுப்த மௌரியரால் வீழ்த்தப்பட்ட கடைசி நந்த மன்னர் ______.

questions.quote: Nalanda - UNESCO World Heritage Site. The word Nalanda is a Sanskrit combination of three words Na + alam + daa meaning 'no stopping of the gift of knowledge'.

options: the land of beautiful lotus flowers
no end to the gift of knowledge
the great city of Buddhist monks
the great university of the Guptas

ta.explanation: Na + alam + daa என்ற மூன்று சொற்களின் இணைப்பு.

questions.quote: Megasthenes was the ambassador of the Greek ruler, Seleucus, in the court of Chandra Gupta. He stayed in India for 14 years. His book Indica is one of the main sources for the study of Mauryan Empire.

en.q: Megasthenes stayed in India for ______ years.
en.explanation: His book Indica is a main source for the Mauryan Empire.

questions.quote: Mauryan Empire – India's First Empire. Capital: Pataliputra (present day Patna, Bihar). Government: Monarchy. Historical era: c. 322 BC (BCE) – 187 BC (BCE). Important Kings: Chandragupta, Bindusara, Ashoka.

en.q: The capital of the Mauryan Empire was ______ (present-day Patna).
en.explanation: The Mauryan era is c. 322-187 BCE.

questions.quote: Grandeur of Pataliputra: The great capital city in the Mauryan Empire, which had 64 gates to the city with 570 watch towers.

en.q: Pataliputra, the Mauryan capital, had ______ gates and 570 watch towers.
en.explanation: It was a grand city of the Mauryan Empire.

ta.q: மௌரியத் தலைநகர் பாடலிபுத்திரத்தில் ______ வாயில்களும் 570 காவல் கோபுரங்களும் இருந்தன.

questions.quote: Ashoka sent his son Mahinda and Sanghamitta to Srilanka to propagate Buddhism. He also sent missionaries to West Asia, Egypt, and Eastern Europe. Ashoka held the third Buddhist Council at his capital Pataliputra.

en.q: Ashoka sent his children ______ to Sri Lanka to propagate Buddhism.
en.explanation: He also sent missionaries to West Asia, Egypt and Eastern Europe.

ta.q: பௌத்தத்தைப் பரப்ப அசோகர் இலங்கைக்கு அனுப்பிய தம் பிள்ளைகள் ______.
ta.explanation: மேற்காசியா, எகிப்து, கிழக்கு ஐரோப்பாவுக்கும் தூதர்களை அனுப்பினார்.

questions.quote: The 33 Edicts on the pillars as well as boulders and cave walls made by the Emperor Ashoka describe in detail Ashoka's belief in peace, righteousness, justice and his concern for the welfare of his people. An Edict is an official order or proclamation issued by a person in authority or a king.

options: a type of gold coin issued by a king
an official order issued by a king or ruler
a Buddhist shrine built in a cave
a tax paid by farmers to the king
en.explanation: Ashoka's 33 edicts were inscribed on pillars, boulders and cave walls.

options: அரசர் வெளியிடும் ஒரு வகைத் தங்க நாணயம்
ta.explanation: அசோகரின் 33 ஆணைகள் தூண்கள், பாறைகள், குகைச் சுவர்களில் பொறிக்கப்பட்டன.

questions.quote: The script of the inscriptions: At Sanchi - Brahmi; At Kandahar - Greek and Aramaic; At North Western part - Kharoshthi.

en.q: The script of Ashoka's inscriptions at Sanchi is ______.
en.explanation: At Kandahar - Greek and Aramaic; in the North West - Kharoshthi.

questions.quote: The land tax (bhaga) collected was 1/6 of the total produce. Ashokan inscription at Lumbini mentions bali and bagha as taxes collected from people.

en.q: The land tax collected in the Mauryan period was called ______.
en.explanation: Bali and bhaga are mentioned as taxes in the Lumbini inscription.

ta.explanation: லும்பினி கல்வெட்டு பலி, பாகம் ஆகிய வரிகளைக் குறிக்கிறது.

questions.quote: The king was the supreme and sovereign authority of the Mauryan Empire. Council of ministers known as mantriparishad assisted the King. King had an excellent spy system. A board of 30 members divided into six committees with five members on each monitored military administration.

en.q: The military administration of the Mauryan Empire was monitored by a board of ______ members divided into six committees.
en.explanation: Each committee had five members; they looked after the navy, armoury, infantry, cavalry, chariots and elephants.

ta.q: மௌரியர் படை நிர்வாகத்தை ஆறு குழுக்களாகப் பிரிக்கப்பட்ட ______ உறுப்பினர் கொண்ட வாரியம் கண்காணித்தது.

questions.quote: The punch marked silver coins (panas) which carry the symbols of the peacock, and the hill and crescent copper coins called Mashakas formed the imperial currency.

en.q: The punch-marked silver coins of the Mauryan imperial currency were called ______.

questions.quote: Reasons for the Decline of the Mauryan Empire: Ashoka's successors were very weak. Continuous revolts. Invasion by the Bactrian Greeks. Last Maurya ruler Brihadratha was killed by his commander Pushyamitra Sungha who established Sungha dynasty.

en.q: The dynasty founded by Pushyamitra after killing Brihadratha was the ______.
en.explanation: Brihadratha, the last Maurya ruler, was killed by his commander.

questions.quote: Ancient name - Modern name: Rajagriha - Rajgir; Pataliputra - Patna; Kalinga - Odisha.

en.q: The modern name of ancient Pataliputra is ______.
en.explanation: Rajagriha is modern Rajgir; Kalinga is Odisha.
